{{Top|leg}}
The '''Bovorian language''' was a series of high-pitched whistles and trills. The sounds were similar to those produced by an [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]]. Some of the sounds produced by the [[Bovorian]]s only registered in the ultrasonic range, which made it hard for other [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash;who could not hear those sounds&mdash;to understand them. For the benefit of these species, Bovorians brought their voices down to lower ranges for them to understand, or even switched to [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] if they felt the need to.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
